title: CardRelations
description: GET /works/{workId}/relations?kind=: relation rows of the work (§6: references come from relation tables). world: world card -> related card (함께 보기, §8). character: character -> character with the relation (관계도). origin: character -> origin region (dex back). parent: region -> its parent region (map areas). episode_region: episode -> region, relation 'main' for locations.main (map badges).

relation.description: The relation text (character), 'main' for an episode's main region; otherwise null.
